instruction: I want to enable the render whitespace feature in VS Code so I can see spaces and tabs as visible characters. Please configure this setting.

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling whitespace rendering in VSCode editor to show all whitespace characters. Evaluator checks if settings.json contains 'editor.renderWhitespace': 'all'. Using existing check_json_settings metric from vscode.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: get_vm_file fetches VS Code settings.json from the correct path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric logic is correct: check_json_settings properly parses JSON and checks that expected key-value pairs exist in the file
Expected value is semantically correct: 'editor.renderWhitespace': 'all' is the correct VS Code setting for enabling whitespace rendering
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement to enable render whitespace feature
Data flow is correct: When expected.type='rule', framework calls get_rule which returns config['rules'], and metric correctly accesses expected['expected'] to get the settings dictionary
Edge cases handled: metric handles missing files and JSON parsing errors appropriately
No postconfig needed: settings.json is a persistent file that doesn't require UI state management
